profile.subtitleJa: シドン人の王、イゼベルの父
profile.summaryJa: エトバアルはシドン人の王で、イゼベルの父として記されています。

wikipedia.title: Ithobaal I
wikipedia.noteJa: この記事はイゼベルの父でティルス王Ithobaalを扱い、注では1 Kings 16:31のヘブライ語表記をʾEṯbaʿalと示します。本文のエトバアルとの対応を示す関連記事として掲載します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: L146 relates Ithobaal’s daughter Jezebel to 1 Kings 16:31 and says the text labels him king of the Sidonians; note L165 gives the Hebrew form Ethbaal. The article heading is Ithobaal I, so relation-only is appropriate.
